chants.vernacular_text: Let my prayer enter into your presence; incline your ear to my supplication, O Lord. ℣. O Lord, God of my salvation, day and night have I cried before you.
Let my prayer ascend like incense in your presence, O Lord. ℣. May the lifting up of my hands be an evening sacrifice.
The five wise virgins took oil in flasks with their lamps; at midnight there was a cry: "Behold, the bridegroom is here; come out to meet Christ the Lord."
He has established peace in your boundaries, and he fills you with the finest wheat.
Guide my footsteps, O Lord, according to your word, so that no iniquity may ever gain the upper hand, O Lord.
The five wise virgins took oil in flasks with their lamps; at midnight there was a cry: "Behold, the bridegroom is here; come out to meet Christ the Lord."
The Lord is my shepherd and I shall want nothing; he has set me in a land of abundant pastures; he has led me to life-renewing waters.
